|strategy=By [mailto:roddd@ucla.edu I-Ming Chen]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/inconsequentialbarriers.html</ref>

Gotta love a good counter card and we have a great one here. This card cancels a few of the top "annoying" cards in the game. Ever had a time where the opponent Barriered or None Shall Passed a key character and then proceeded to beat down on your forces instead? How about the opponent tracking a high destiny and then using [[Set For Stun]] to "eject" a pilot on your [[Millennium Falcon{{!}}Falcon]] back to your hand? Well, that won't happen as much any more since you now have a secret weapon against tactics like that.

And just in case the opponent isn't playing with any of those strong interrupts, you can recycle this card in your deck with the secondary usage which in itself is very useful. If you find a great card you want to draw, you can "save" it for later by putting it at the bottom. Also, you might have found a good destiny card you like or want to change a destiny your opponent put on your Reserve Deck. There are tons of possibilities here.
